jobs.description:
As a Bilingual Accountant in the public sector, you will manage financial operations AZ and ensure compliance with relevant regulations. This position offers a variety of responsibilities and benefits for a skilled professional in accounting and finance.

Client Details

An organisation operating in the public sector.

Description

As an Accountant AZ your responsibilities are:

• Prepare and maintain accurate financial records and reports.
• Ensure compliance with accounting standards and public sector regulations.
• Manage accounts payable and receivable processes.
• Assist in the preparation of budgets and financial forecasts.
• Coordinate with external auditors and provide necessary documentation.
• Reconcile bank statements and monitor cash flow activities.
• Prepare and submit tax declarations and other regulatory filings.
• Provide financial insights and support decision-making processes.

A successful Bilingual Accountant should have:

• Proficiency in accounting principles and financial reporting.
• Strong knowledge of Winbooks.
• Fluency in English and French.
• Strong knowledge of public sector financial regulations.
• Residence in Brussels.
• Valid EU work permit.
• Experience at least 1 year in accounting.
• Attention to detail and excellent problem-solving skills.
• Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines efficiently.

Your future job

As a production operator, you’ll provide support to the press operator during the production process. You’ll make sure that the glue goes into the correct glue tank and closely monitor the glue levels. In addition, you’ll welcome drivers and direct them to the right location.

You’ll also be responsible for maintenance tasks and cleaning the equipment, ensuring everything runs safely and smoothly.

In short: a varied role where you play an important part in keeping the production process efficient and well-organized!

Who are you?

• 
You speak good English and can communicate easily on the work floor.

• 
You’re not afraid of physical work and like to get things done.

• 
You don’t mind getting your hands dirty.

• 
You’re motivated to work in a 6-shift system.

About the role
 

Fintensy builds and operates the technology platform behind mozzeno and other financial services. As we scale, we're looking for a Head of IT to grow our engineering team, sharpen how we work, and make sure our technology delivers on the business's ambitions.
 

This is a leadership role first and foremost. You will spend your time developing people, aligning ways of working, leading our technical initiatives, and giving stakeholders clear visibility into what the team is building and where it is headed. While you won't be writing production code day to day, your credibility with the team comes from having built and operated systems like these yourself.
 

Key responsibilities
 
 

• Team leadership & coaching — Provide mentorship and day-to-day support to developers and data scientists, fostering a culture of continuous learning. Help senior engineers grow junior colleagues and keep knowledge flowing across the team. 

• Technical project leadership — Lead the delivery of technical projects end to end — infrastructure, platform, security, tooling and cross-cutting engineering initiatives — from scoping through rollout. Business-driven projects are owned by Product Owners; you partner closely with them while taking the lead on the technical roadmap and its execution. 

• Recruitment & onboarding — Lead hiring for developers, infrastructure engineers, and data & AI specialists. Design and oversee onboarding that integrates new hires quickly and effectively into the team and its practices. 

• Process refinement — Work with Product Owners to shape and fine-tune agile practices (backlog management, sprint planning, retrospectives) that maximise productivity and keep focus on strategic priorities. Continuously trial new techniques — such as AI-assisted coding and process automation — to raise efficiency and quality. 

• Visibility & communication — Ensure transparent reporting of achievements, roadmaps and risks to stakeholders. Run regular updates on progress, risks and resource needs, and build a shared understanding of priorities across engineering, product and business. 

• Collaboration & facilitation — Act as the bridge between developers, Product Owners, data scientists and external partners. Facilitate discussions on requirements and dependencies so projects run smoothly and teams stay aligned. 

• Technical oversight — Bring deep, hands-on experience with our stack or equivalent (AWS, .NET, Angular, Python, event-driven micro-services), enough real depth to debug a production issue or challenge an architectural decision yourself, not just follow the conversation.  Champion security best practices and infrastructure improvements, while delegating implementation to subject-matter experts. 

• Culture & growth — Foster an environment where engineers feel accountable and empowered to take ownership. Encourage curiosity and a pragmatic, solution-oriented mindset, and promote AI and emerging tools that streamline work and sharpen the team's skills. 
 

• Several years of hands-on experience as a Software Engineer, Architect, or DevOps/Platform Engineer, ideally followed by a move into a people-management or tech-lead role. 
 

• Experience managing engineering or cross-functional teams, with a track record of coaching people and growing their skills. 

• A record of leading technical projects or initiatives through to delivery. 

• Proven ability to design and refine agile or lean processes that improve delivery effectiveness. 

• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills; comfortable presenting plans, progress and blockers to technical and non-technical audiences alike. 

• Organised and detail-oriented, able to juggle multiple initiatives without losing sight of the big picture. 

• Comfortable introducing new tools and techniques (e.g., AI-assisted development) and measuring their impact. 

• Enough technical literacy in cloud infrastructure, web technologies and DevOps pipelines to understand team challenges and shape high-level decisions. 

• Fluency in French or Dutch alongside professional English.  

Nice to have
 
 

• Prior experience in fintech or other regulated environments. 

• Experience working with near-shore or hybrid teams.

Launched in 2017, 
mozzeno is a 100% Belgian digital lender that has established itself as a key player in the credit market.
 

Every day, we help individuals and businesses finance their projects through a simple, fast and fully digital process. Our strength? A unique blend of technology and human support, allowing us to deliver an efficient and personalised service.

In parallel, we give investors the opportunity to actively support the real economy in Belgium by financing the loans granted by mozzeno.
 

Based in 
Louvain-la-Neuve and currently experiencing strong growth, mozzeno is looking for an 
AI Automation Engineer to design, orchestrate and AI-augment our business processes.
 

Job content
 

As an AI Automation Engineer, you will design, build and maintain a portfolio of automation solutions that support mozzeno's teams and business processes — increasingly powered by AI.

Concretely, you will:
 
 

• Build automations with Python and PowerShell — scripts, integrations and services that connect our applications, move and transform data, and remove manual steps across the organisation. 

• Design and ship AI-powered workflows using Dify — our AI workflow platform — to orchestrate LLM-based steps (document processing, classification, extraction, drafting, internal assistants and agents) and embed them safely into our business processes. 

• Orchestrate end-to-end processes across our tools and systems — understanding how each application delivers part of the overall solution, and building the integrations and logic that make them work together reliably from one end to the other. 

• Develop functional expertise in our solution architecture, digging into the operational reality of each process to identify pain points and formulate solutions that genuinely improve the way we work. 

• Manage and get the most out of the external tools used by our teams, keeping them current, well-integrated and delivering real value. 
 

• You have a degree in computer science, or you are self-taught with tangible IT experience. 

• You are 
proficient in Python and PowerShell for automation, scripting and integration work — comfortable working with APIs, manipulating data, and building reliable, maintainable code. 

• You have a genuine interest in 
AI and LLMs, and ideally hands-on experience building workflows with 
Dify (or similar tools such as n8n, LangChain, Make, or comparable LLM-orchestration platforms). You are familiar with concepts such as 
prompting, RAG, embeddings, agentic workflows and tool/function calling, and understand how to put an LLM to work reliably inside a business process. 

• You are comfortable 
integrating and orchestrating systems through APIs, and think naturally about how tools and processes fit together end to end. 

• You are at ease in a 
cloud environment (Google, AWS). 

• You are naturally eager to learn the big picture, to dive into the functional and operational aspects of a business process, to understand the details and pain points, and to formulate solutions to improve them. 

• You have excellent problem-solving skills and can judge when to involve peers or experts. 

• You are detail-oriented, with strong organisational skills and the ability to manage several tasks and projects at once. 

• You have excellent communication and collaboration skills, and the ability to work with a range of stakeholders across the organisation. 

• You can work effectively in French & English, and Dutch is always an asset

BOORTMALT is a global malting company with a 3 million tonnes production capacity. The group is present on 5 continents with 27 malting plants. Boortmalt's expertise is widely acknowledged by brewers, distillers, and food industries, who rely on the supply of top-quality barley malts.

The Boortmalt Group is a fully owned subsidiary of the agricultural and agribusiness cooperative Axereal. Our relationship with Axereal, Europe's largest grain cooperative, ensures us access to high-quality barley year-round.

To strengthen our European quality team, we are looking for a Quality & Administration Specialist - a detail-oriented and proactive professional who will support data management, quality reporting, and administrative processes across our European cluster.

As a Quality & Administration Specialist, you will be the key point of contact for managing master data, quality data, and reporting within our ERP systems. You will ensure accurate and timely data entry, support the quality department with reporting, and contribute to the administrative follow-up of quality-related processes in Europe.

 

As a key member of our European quality team, you will:

• Manage master data and ERP systems: Maintain customer and product specifications in MAPPS and JDE, ensure accurate stock allocation, and support colleagues as an ERP key user.
• Prepare quality reports: Generate clear, actionable internal and client reports, continuously improving reporting tools and templates.
• Coordinate samples and budgets: Organize external sample analyses, track quality-related purchase orders, and support invoice processing for the European cluster.
• Support lab operations: Ensure compliance with laboratory standards, investigate anomalies, and manage records of non-conformities.

• Bachelor's degree in preferably in a technical field: Agriculture, Agronomy, Food science, Chemistry or a related discipline.
• Experienced with ERP systems (preferably MAPPS and/or JDE) and accurate data management.
• Profound knowledge of Excell.
• Highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive.
• Strong analytical skills and a client-oriented approach.
• Good communicator
• Intrest in or knowledge of malting/brewing processes is a plus
• Fluent in Dutch and English; knowledge of other European languages is a plus.

SCADA Developer - The role
We're looking for a Senior SCADA Developer to help build and evolve a critical control centre platform for remote operations and distance piloting. You'll develop reliable, secure, and scalable solutions in an environment where resilience, operational continuity, and cybersecurity are essential. We value people who combine technical expertise with curiosity and a solution-oriented mindset.

 

SCADA Developer - The profile
• Senior experience in SCADA development or industrial control systems.
• Strong algorithmic thinking and problem-solving skills.
• Cybersecurity mindset, with an understanding of critical systems and secure-by-design principles.
• Clear communicator with excellent spoken and written English.
• Curious, pragmatic, and collaborative approach.
• Experience with SCIL is a plus, but training will be provided.

As a sales assistant in this exclusive chocolate shop, everything revolves around experience, quality, and service. You welcome customers from all over the world with a smile, provide professional advice, and make sure every visitor leaves the store happy – with a delicious purchase.

On a typical day, you keep the store tidy, take care of product presentation, and actively assist customers. You process deliveries, monitor stock, and work closely with your colleagues to ensure smooth operations during peak times. You’re flexible, including during weekends and busy holiday periods.

Does a job where service, team spirit, and quality are key appeal to you? Then this is your chance to develop yourself in a unique retail environment. Apply today and discover if this role suits you!

Are you a recent graduate or have had a positive first work experience in a marketing services environment and looking for a role where you can learn fast, take ownership, work with clients in an international environment, and make a real impact from day one?

A forward thinker who anticipates obstacles, identifies opportunities, and consistently stays one step ahead. Comfortable working independently, making sound decisions, and driving initiatives forward with limited supervision, while also recognizing the value of collaboration and actively contributing to a strong team environment. Someone who thrives on solving problems, improving processes, and turning challenges into opportunities for growth and success.

You thrive in a fast-paced environment, build strong relationships with colleagues and clients, and bring a practical, can-do approach to business challenges. While previous experience in a similar role is an advantage, we place greater value on attitude, drive, pro-activeness, learning agility, and the potential to make a meaningful impact from day one. No two days are the same. One day you might be coordinating a client project, the next day you could be visiting our warehouse partners, analysing operational performance, or identifying opportunities to improve processes and customer experience.

During your first years with our client, you'll gain experience in:

jobs.occupation: Senior Internal Communications & Project Support Officer
jobs.description:
📋 Tasks and responsibilities

To support the Global Environment, Health & Safety (EHS) team during a temporary absence, we are looking for a Project & Communication Support Officer who will provide broad operational, administrative, and coordination support across several global EHS initiatives.

This role combines project support, stakeholder coordination, communication activities, event organization, and administrative follow-up. You will work with internal and external stakeholders and help ensure the smooth delivery of international EHS programs.

Scope of the role

You will contribute to a range of strategic initiatives, with a strong focus on flexibility in task content. The assignment includes leading both larger and smaller projects or events, supporting other project managers, and providing overall administrative assistance. A hands-on approach is essential.

Examples of ongoing initiatives

• Global Safety Commitment Day
• Coordinate a global awareness and engagement campaign for employees worldwide.
• Liaise with external and internal training providers, translation agencies, and communication teams.
• Support the preparation of communication materials, presentations, and stakeholder updates.
• Coordinate deliverables and follow up with multiple international stakeholders.
• EHS Awards Program
• Coordinate the full awards process, from submission intake through jury review to leadership presentations.
• Organize and support the logistics of the awards event.
• Coordinate suppliers, purchasing activities, and event-related follow-up.
• Ensure smooth communication with all stakeholders involved.
• Support budget follow-up and administrative activities linked to the EHS department.
Primary responsibilities

• Provide communication and project coordination support across multiple global EHS initiatives and engagement campaigns.
• Independently draft, prepare, and review internal communications, announcements, presentations, and stakeholder materials to a professional standard.
• Support awareness and engagement campaigns while ensuring clear and consistent messaging.
• Coordinate with external suppliers, training partners, translation agencies, and internal teams to ensure timely and accurate delivery of content.
• Prepare stakeholder updates, management presentations, and campaign-related materials.
• Organize meetings, prepare agendas, capture actions, and follow up on commitments.
• Coordinate project planning, timelines, actions, and deliverables for assigned initiatives.
• Monitor progress and proactively follow up with stakeholders.
• Support the organization of global events and engagement activities, including logistics.
• Maintain project documentation and reporting tools.
• Send reminders and ensure action follow-up through email and Microsoft Teams.
• Provide general administrative and operational support, including budget follow-up, purchase requests, and invoice tracking.

• Proven hands-on experience as an Internal Communications Officer or in a similar communication-focused role.
• At least 3 years of relevant experience in internal communications.
• A relevant educational background in communication, marketing, journalism, public relations, or a related field; a Master's degree in a closely related domain is also suitable.
• Experience working in an international and multicultural environment.
• Experience preparing professional presentations and communication materials.
• Experience in project coordination and organizational or administrative support.
• Budget tracking and administrative support experience is a strong asset.
• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Excellent organizational and planning abilities.
• Hands-on mindset, with the flexibility to combine administrative work and coordination tasks.
• Detail-oriented, proactive, and able to manage multiple priorities effectively.
• Strong sense of ownership and accountability.
• Collaborative team player, comfortable interacting with stakeholders at different levels.
• Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Teams, and Outlook.
• Fluent in Dutch and English, with the ability to prepare presentations and communication materials in both languages with a high degree of accuracy.
• Conversational French for daily interaction in the Brussels office.

jobs.description:
As Administrative Assistant, you will provide operational and administrative support to the Estates team. The position would suit someone who genuinely enjoys administrative coordination, document follow-up and contract management, and who is comfortable working in a dynamic environment. You are fluent in French, Dutch and English. The position is possible in 4/5th of Full Time.

Our client is a well-established international company managing an extensive real estate portfolio across Belgium.The company offers a stable environment, a collaborative culture and the opportunity to contribute to projects that have a tangible impact across the country. Description
